name: Petra Blumentritt
source: A college grad from Germany that had a major in quantum physics. She helped with the building on the time window. On their first attempt, something went wrong and Petra never came out. However, they found out she was still alive thanks to the sticky notes they found. This is because Petra usually wrote down some of her ideas on sticky notes.
